messages:
alex_k: Heads up—CI for fleet-provision (infra) is flaking on `terraform plan` again, started ~5m ago. Lots of failures where the runner gets preempted mid-run and state stays locked.

maria_o: :eyes: saw a couple of those. Logs show a state lock held by `gha-runner-12` then the runner disappears.

sam_irwin: I pulled one of the failed runs. Error looks like: 

infra-bot: [terraform] ERROR: Error locking state: ConditionalCheckFailedException: The conditional request failed (HTTP 400)

jen: also getting intermittent cache restore 500s from our S3 gateway during the same window: `RestoreCache failed: 500 Internal Server Error` so `terraform init -backend-config` sometimes retries then gives up.

alex_k: Our self-hosted runners are on spot-style nodes (k8s autoscaler). We had a node preemption event at 17:02 according to cluster-alerts. Autoscaler restarted pods and the GH runner pod lost ephemeral workspace.

maria_o: That matches. The autoscaler scale-down window shortened after the cluster upgrade yesterday. Might be too aggressive for long infra jobs.

sam_irwin: Temporary mitigation: adding `concurrency: group: fleet-provision-${{ github.ref }}` to the workflow so only one apply per branch runs at a time. But this doesn't help if runner disappears mid-apply and Terraform leaves the lock.

jen: We could add a step to run `terraform force-unlock` in a follow-up job if we detect a lost-runner state, but that's dangerous. Need guardrails and a human in the loop.

alex_k: Agreed — do not auto-unlock without review. Short-term I'd like to: 1) pin the autoscaler to keep at least 2 runner nodes online during deploy windows; 2) make cache restore more resilient (more retries/backoff) and fall back to cold init instead of failing the whole job; 3) add metadata to locks so we can see which runner/PR created them.

ops-runner: I've created a quick patch to the workflow to increase cache restore retries and to upload the workspace tarball on failure to a temp S3 key for debugging. Will open PR.

maria_o: Also let's change the runner affinity for infra workflows to a dedicated runner-pool label `infra-runners` which is provisioned on non-preemptible nodes. That will cost more but reduces flakiness for terraform/helm.

sam_irwin: +1. For Helm: noticed `helm diff` step timed out because the tiller-equivalent job got OOMKilled when node preempted. We'll move helm jobs to infra-runners too.

alex_k: Can someone from platform schedule a short rollback of the autoscaler change or at least lift the aggressive scale-down today? If not, we'll set a maintenance window and pin node count.

jen: I'll slack @infra-oncall and file an incident-tagged ticket with the autoscaler team. Also adding a short runbook: how to detect orphaned terraform locks and the safe steps to release them.

infra-bot: Deploy bot: workflow patch PR opened -> #3452; CI rerun scheduled on infra-runners.

alex_k: Thanks. Action items: jen (contact autoscaler + post runbook), ops-runner (PR for retries & workspace upload), maria_o (runner pool request), sam_irwin (helm job affinity). We'll reconvene in 30m. :thumbsup:
